text: ‘Transnational organisations have contributed to an increase in global inequality.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
OR
‘Global migration has only negative consequences for developing countries.’ Evaluate this view.
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Postmodernists have exaggerated the influence of the media in people’s lives today.’ Evaluate
this view. [35]
OR
‘Governments have no control over media content.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religious organisations serve the interests of the ruling class.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Religion has less social significance today than in the past.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
